name: Forge a weapon! [ALPHA]
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Forge a Weapon! 🔥

Are you ready to Forge your very own Weapons? Buy Metals from the shop when they Restock and wait for them to Smelt, Forge them and collect the profits!
Flex Weapons and cool Metals on friends, and have fun!

💰 Buy Metals at the Market and put them in your Furnace.
⚒️ Forge Metals on your Anvil. 
🍀 You get RARE VFX on your Epic Swords when you hit the Jackpot! 🔮
💎 Flex your Weapons, or Sell them at the Market. 🤑
🔄 The Market will Restock new Metals!
🔮 Experience rare Events that give Special VFX to your Weapons.

Remember, your Forge literally Smelts while you are offline ⭐
